# Output and contract schemas

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py. Do not edit by hand; run the script. -->

Every Pydantic model in `src/bidwright/schemas.py`, in definition order. Code validates every model response and every record against these before it reaches state or a file.

## `Record`

Base for stored records: unknown fields are errors, so drift fails loudly.

No fields.

## `Facing`

Base for what an LLM sees or returns. Extra keys from the model are ignored.

No fields.
